legacy.scope: Original isolated store APIs and declared cache/index/SQL fixtures; these approved setup operations are separate from permission enforcement. Warm target coverage is explicit; an empty pre-mutation result does not prove invalidation of a previously returned record.

context.scope: Original isolated store APIs and declared cache/index/SQL fixtures; these approved setup operations are separate from permission enforcement. Warm target coverage is explicit; an empty pre-mutation result does not prove invalidation of a previously returned record.

legacy.scope: Frozen supported-check failures, with retrieval absence separated from a wrong field on an actually returned record; no generated-answer failures are inferred.

context.scope: Frozen supported-check failures, with retrieval absence separated from a wrong field on an actually returned record; no generated-answer failures are inferred.

actual_model_diagnostics.scope: Twenty prospectively selected public development scenarios, two original guarded session arms. Separate selector inspection is a diagnostic after native refusal, not an actual generated response or a direct trace of native cause.

native_admission_attempt_ms.scope: Native MemoryAwareSession request boundary before separate post-refusal selector inspection; no model latency claim.

requested_evaluation_options.scope: Requested bounded evaluation settings; no actual generation HTTP payload was sent.

limitations: Every holdout case retains actual response/action requirements as unmeasured; 58/71 supported passing cases are PARTIAL, never full PASS.
Project resolution uses the original resolver diagnostic, not model or native-session identification.
Precision on returned records does not reward empty positive answers; all 94 relevant IDs remain in recall denominator.
Actual LAYA B disabled. Controlled advisory faults and optional deterministic D are not LAYA inference.
No post-holdout retries, oracle-guided repairs or prompt changes.
Native final model attempts all blocked; no actual parameter payload, generated tokens or answer accuracy can be claimed.
Low sample size and purposively authored scenarios: no population-confidence interval or production service guarantee.

One frozen oracle simultaneously requires exclusion and inspection of the excluded returned record status. Its literal failure remains in each arm; this is an authored-oracle contradiction, not an observed wrong status value. Recall and project counts are unaffected.

The three final whole-record serialization checks per arm receive empty contexts. Their literal pass proves no truncation in those receipts, but does not exercise serialization of a returned record. Independent development controls provide the separate populated-record evidence.

native_context_tokens.scope: Actual installed native tokenizer applied to already executed private synthetic holdout contexts, including declared warm retrievals; no new retrieval or inference, no LAYA call, no model response or injected-prompt accuracy claim.
